compare_modular_files: compare modular_xxx.py files with their generated modeling_xxx.py files to find differences
check_modular_conversion_fix: fix and overwrite modeling_xxx.py files that differ from their modular source conversions
run_modular_conversion_parallel: run modular conversion checks in parallel across all modular model files using multiprocessing
find_models_in_diff: find all model directories that have been modified in the current git diff against main
check_guaranteed_no_diff: check if a modular file is guaranteed to have no diff based on dependency and model change analysis
